title: euthamia tenuifolia var. pycnocephala
intro: Euthamia tenuifolia var. pycnocephala, commonly known as bitter goldenrod, is a perennial plant native to North America. Bitter goldenrod has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, and it has been used to treat various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of bitter goldenrod include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in treating colds and coughs. The bioactive constituents of bitter goldenrod include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
